      try {
        version = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('version') || ''
      } catch {}
      // 统一调用客户端 API（接收对象，运行时编码为 base64）
      const callClientApi = (data) => {
        const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode(JSON.stringify(data))
        const base64Cmd = btoa(String.fromCharCode.apply(null, bytes))
        const cmd = `jsAsynCall("${base64Cmd}")`
        if (_cefQuery) {

          _jsAsynCall(cmd)

      window.__perfProbe = function (name, extra) {
        var t = performance.now()
        var marks = window.__PERF_PROBE_MARKS__
        var prev = marks._last
        var pageVisit = marks.page_visit
        marks[name] = t
        marks._last = t
        console.log(
          '[PerfProbe]',
          name,
          Object.assign(
            {
              sinceNavMs: Math.round(t),
              sincePrevMs: prev != null ? Math.round(t - prev) : null,
              sincePageVisitMs: pageVisit != null ? Math.round(t - pageVisit) : null,
              at: Date.now(),
            },
            extra || {},
          ),
        )
      }

      window.__perfProbeRecord = function (content) {
        try {
          var key = 'PERF_PROBE_SAMPLES_V1'
          var navId = performance.timeOrigin || Date.now()
          var list = []
          try {
            list = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '[]')
          } catch (e) {
            list = []
          }
          if (!Array.isArray(list)) list = []
          var sample = null
          for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            if (list[i] && list[i].navId === navId) {
              sample = list[i]
              break
            }
          }
          if (!sample) {
            sample = {
              navId: navId,
              at: Date.now(),
              path: location.pathname + location.search,
              fed_version: (content && content.fed_version) || '',
              version: String((content && content.version) || ''),
              resource_type: (content && content.resource_type) || '',
              page_visit: null,
              first_collect: null,
              reported: [],
              marks: {},
              nav: null,
              lcp: 0,
              full_load_time: null,

          }

          if (content && content.version != null) sample.version = String(content.version)
          if (content && content.type && sample.reported.indexOf(content.type) < 0) {
            sample.reported.push(content.type)
          }
          if (content && content.type === 'page_visit' && typeof content.metrics_time === 'number') {
            sample.page_visit = Math.round(content.metrics_time)
          }
          if (content && content.type === 'first-collect' && typeof content.metrics_time === 'number') {
            sample.first_collect = Math.round(content.metrics_time)
          }
          if (list.length > 50) list = list.slice(-50)
          localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(list))
        } catch (e) {}
      }

          method: 'common.report.dataWarehouseSend',

            content: pageVisitContentSsr,
          },
